scope: Independent reference and native-distance review, Blender only
observations: Tip-mounted reference variant preserves the collar, lugs, flared base and short stem. The day view retains the LED carrier with darker red edges and stronger skirt rings. Night and 30% LowPower remain red with a compact warm core and smooth local halo. The 12 m mesh reads as a small fixture; at 150/450 m it becomes a red signal cluster. Mapped optics do not reproduce refractive depth.
changes: Deepened red at the dome silhouette and lower band, strengthened skirt rings, reduced whole-dome emission and tightened the smooth red halo around the compact LED column. Retained the tip-mount collar, clamp lugs, stepped stem and M-class LODs. Corrected excess UV density at the dome tip by reducing chart scale; no geometry was removed.
limits: Opaque mapped glass has no true transmission/parallax. Measurable subpixel shading/brightness differences remain at the forced LOD switch; strict no-pop acceptance is still a producer/runtime review item.
